title: Paul McCartney live: Stade de France, Paris | 2004
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Stade de France in Paris, France, on 24 June 2004.

It was the penultimate show of the 04 Summer Tour, which lasted for 14 dates in May and June 2004.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney returned to the Stade de France on 11 June 2015 during the Out There Tour.
